answer.rationale: Prioritize an expedited incumbent renewal negotiation: use market benchmarking and a multi-year volume commitment to pursue the mandated spend reduction while preserving the incumbent integration and scheduled-delivery continuity. The line has effectively no delivery buffer, so switching primary supply or deferring expiry creates disproportionate interruption risk. Verify the original pricing and term records before committing because the achievable savings versus the 18% target remains uncertain.
